workflow.name: Automated QR Ticket Scanner & Validator
workflow.description: Triggers on new QR scan data, validates ticket codes against a database, and appends results (VALID/TIDAK VALID) to a results sheet. Google Sheets mocked with local JSON.

TICKET_DB_PATH.description: Path to ticket database JSON file

SCAN_RESULTS_PATH.description: Path to scan results JSON file

FORM_RESPONSES_PATH.description: Path to form responses JSON file

workflow_steps.name: get_form_responses
workflow_steps.description: Simulate Google Sheets trigger - read all form responses (QR scan submissions).

workflow_steps.name: select_latest_item
workflow_steps.description: Select the latest (last) item from the triggered data.

workflow_steps.name: set_ticket_code
workflow_steps.description: Extract QR code value as kode_tiket for lookup.

workflow_steps.name: read_ticket_rows
workflow_steps.description: Look up ticket in the database by ticket code (filter TIKET = kode_tiket).

workflow_steps.name: validate_ticket
workflow_steps.description: Route by conditional rules: VALID if ticket matches, TIDAK VALID otherwise.

workflow_steps.name: append_valid_result
workflow_steps.description: VALID path: Append scan result with full participant info and STATUS=VALID.

workflow_steps.name: read_form_responses_for_invalid
workflow_steps.description: TIDAK VALID path: Read form responses sheet to get context.

workflow_steps.name: select_latest_form_response
workflow_steps.description: Select the latest form response from the responses sheet.

workflow_steps.name: append_invalid_result
workflow_steps.description: Append scan result with placeholder data and STATUS=TIDAK VALID.
source_nodes: Append to Scan Results Sheet (Google Sheets)
